Why Midland businesses miss calls

Midland is the business hub of the Permian Basin, one of the country’s largest oil-producing regions. Its median household income, about $90,000, is well above other West Texas cities. Oilfield services, equipment repair and trucking run long hours in remote places where cell coverage can be weak. Crews and owners can be out of reach for much of the day, so calls need someone or something to catch them.

Which Midland businesses benefit most?

  • HVAC and contractors: West Texas heat and a busy housing market keep crews booked.
  • Auto and truck repair: Work trucks that stop earn nothing, so drivers need fast answers.
  • Real estate agents: Workers relocating to the basin call from out of town.
